controlled_slices.method: descriptive adjacent-pi finite differences of stored gas and fuel mass flows; no fit, correlation, ranking, interpolation, or physics recalculation

pressure_ratio.dual_split_definition: unit ratios are pi**w and pi**(1-w); the second is formed as pi / first so the floating product is preserved

limitations: MISSING_COMPRESSOR_PHYSICS: no map, blading, corrected flow, speed, diameter, surge or diffusion model
MISSING_TURBINE_STAGE_PHYSICS: no stage count, velocity triangles, cooling or map
MISSING_GEARBOX_PROPELLER: no ratio, speed, propeller load or control law
MISSING_COOLING_BLEED: no cooling, leak, bleed or return flow in this variant
MISSING_THERMOCHEMISTRY_VALIDATION: calc_g_m and the selected alpha polynomial are retained project assumptions, not independently validated
GAS_PROPERTY_BASIS: compressor mean-temperature variable k; turbine constant cp/k at the turbine inlet total temperature
TOTAL_STATES_ONLY: prescribed turbine outlet is a total pressure
experiment.plan_order: ascending pi for SINGLE_SHAFT_SINGLE_CC (11 points), then ascending pi for FREE_POWER_TURBINE (11 points), then ascending pi with split weights 0.4, 0.5, 0.6 for SINGLE_SHAFT_DUAL_CC (33 points)
